---
title: "Базовый прогон модели"
format: html
---

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: true

# 1. Ortam ve Paketlerin Yüklenmesi
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(normpath(joinpath(@__DIR__, "../../..")))
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"

using Random
using DataFrames
using CSV
using Plots

include(srcdir("SIRPetri.jl"))
using .SIRPetri

# 2. Параметры (Parametreler)
println("Инициализация параметров...")
β = 0.3
γ = 0.1
tmax = 100.0

# 3. Создаём сеть (Ağ Oluşturma)
net, u0, states = build_sir_network(β, γ)

# 4. Детерминированная симуляция (Deterministik Simülasyon)
df_det = simulate_deterministic(net, u0, (0.0, tmax), saveat = 0.5, rates = [β, γ])
CSV.write(datadir("sir_det.csv"), df_det)

# 5. Стохастическая симуляция (Stokastik Simülasyon)
Random.seed!(123)
df_stoch = simulate_stochastic(net, u0, (0.0, tmax), rates = [β, γ])
CSV.write(datadir("sir_stoch.csv"), df_stoch)

# 6. Графики (Grafikler ve Çizimler)
p_det = plot_sir(df_det)
savefig(plotsdir("sir_det_dynamics.png"))

p_stoch = plot_sir(df_stoch)
savefig(plotsdir("sir_stoch_dynamics.png"))

println("Базовый прогон завершён. Результаты в data/ и plots/")
